native_sampling.coverage_note: All saved native samples retained, including any startup/control/seek periods. Native process sampling begins after process discovery and ends before/at cleanup; it is not continuous sensor coverage.

notes: VmRSS, VmHWM and VmSwap are exact /proc/<pid>/status fields in kB.
DRM values retain their exact fdinfo field names and units; duplicate client IDs per device are sampled once.
Field type or unit changes are retained as separate observations; maxima are compared only within the same unit.
DRM client maxima can occur at different times; do not add maxima or combine them with RSS as a total or shared GPU peak.
CPU seconds cover the first through last successful sample, excluding earlier process work.
Process count fields retain exact stat/status names; status context-switch counts describe the main thread. Compare cumulative counters only within the same PID/start identity.
Full rows stream to the optional trace; observer memory retains per-process/client maxima and first/last counters rather than sample history.

native_sampling.memory_scope: Native and supervisor /proc status kB are separate process peaks. DRM client maxima retain exact names/units and are not summed with RSS or with each other. Observed CPU seconds exclude earlier work before the first successful process sample.
native_sampling.thermal_scope: 85/95 C are descriptive inclusive reporting thresholds, not new acceptance gates. Consecutive hot-sample spans and neighbor-cool brackets do not prove continuous temperature between samples or establish sustained-hot duration. Other mapped sensors are start/end snapshots only.
native_sampling.power_scope: Denied RAPL energy fields are unavailable, not zero energy or power. Sampled policy/frequency changes and kernel throttle values are descriptive; no causal attribution of latency.

cpu.stale_and_cancellation_scope: All new loads/seeks followed the previous complete event. Zero discarded/cancelled events and zero cancel_count do not exercise active-request cancellation, stale-result rejection or hardware preemption. The three seeks compare recorded full suffixes to their same-backend continuous baseline; this facts helper checks their recorded parity/hashes and does not replay excluded PCM.
cpu.audio_ui_scope: No audio playback or UI load was launched. No callback/xrun/physical-audio or UI-cadence result is supplied by these runs.

limits: Four23.4-second mixtures,16 continuous hops/backend; this is not a sustained music, audio/UI-load or thermal-soak qualification.
CPU precedes Vulkan and controls are sequential; sampled policy/frequency/thermal differences confound causal/backend timing comparisons.
No isolated reference stems or accepted human-listening verdict; timing/seek parity is not musical-quality acceptance.
No active cancellation, audio callback/physical audio, UI behavior or hardware preemption claim from these new runs.
Native trace sensor observations retain startup and seeks where sampled; between-sample temperatures and unmonitored source periods are unknown.
